snippet.title: Project DeepWeb: Eternal Nightmare - Official Trailer (2026)
snippet.description:
Out now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3756870
Watch the Official Trailer of Project DeepWeb: Eternal Nightmare, coming August 17 on PC.

#PDWEternalNightmare #NightCatStudios​

Follow us:
Website: https://nightcatstudios.com​
Twitter: https://twitter.com/nightcatstudios​
Discord: https://nightcat.eu/discord

About Project DeepWeb: Eternal Nightmare:
Project DeepWeb: Eternal Nightmare is a desktop-like adventure game about exploration of the Deep Internet, a sequel to Project DeepWeb. Inspired by Internet lore and real netstalking experience, it tells a story of a person who got stuck in the wrong place at the wrong time.

Learn more: https://nightcatstudios.com/projects/pdw-eternal-nightmare
Available now:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3756870
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/project-deepweb-eternal-nightmare-88d1a8

Wishlist now:
PlayStation™Store: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10015685

About NightCat Studios:
We are a multidirectional creative studio founded in Ukraine in 2017. We do everything we'd like to create: author original games, movies, music and in future there will be more.
